description: This Java class, TicketMetricsService, is a Spring service responsible for processing uploaded Excel (.xlsx) files to compute ticket metrics. It reads the file, validates the format, extracts relevant data, performs aggregations for each application-month pair, and computes various ticket-related statistics and rates.

classes.name: TicketMetricsService
classes.description: Service that reads uploaded Excel files, validates contents, and computes aggregated ticket metrics per application and month.

methods.name: processUpload
methods.description: Validates the input file, parses its Excel content, and computes ticket metrics, returning a list of TicketMetric objects.

methods.name: validateFile
methods.description: Checks if the uploaded file is present, within size limits, and of the correct MIME type and extension.

methods.name: readHeader
methods.description: Reads the header row to map column names (normalized to lower case with underscores) to their indices.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Utility to check if a string is null or empty.

methods.name: getIntegerCell
methods.description: Extracts an integer value from a cell, handling different cell types.

methods.name: getDoubleCell
methods.description: Extracts a double value from a cell, handling different cell types.

methods.name: getStringCell
methods.description: Extracts a string value from a cell, handling different cell types including dates.

methods.name: safeAdd
methods.description: Safely adds Integer or Double values, treating null as zero.

methods.name: clampRate
methods.description: Clamps a rate between 0 and 100, rounding to two decimal places.
